K-1.def: a round fruit you can eat
K-1.clip: Sam has an apple. He gives half to Lu.
K-1.clipEs: Sam le da la mitad de una manzana a Lu.

K-1.def: pages with words and pictures
K-1.clip: Maya picks a book about frogs. She reads it on the rug.
K-1.clipEs: Maya elige un libro sobre ranas y lo lee en la alfombra.

K-1.def: a small pet with soft fur
K-1.clip: The cat sits in the sun. Then it naps on a chair.
K-1.clipEs: El gato se sienta al sol y luego duerme en una silla.

K-1.def: a pet that barks and runs
K-1.clip: Omar walks his dog in the park. The dog sees a ball.
K-1.clipEs: Omar pasea a su perro en el parque. El perro ve una pelota.

K-1.def: the bright star we see in the day
K-1.clip: The sun comes up in the morning. We play outside.
K-1.clipEs: El sol sale por la mañana. Jugamos afuera.
K-1.q: When does the sun come up?

K-1.def: water that falls from clouds
K-1.clip: Dark clouds come. Rain falls on the roof.
K-1.clipEs: Llegan nubes oscuras. La lluvia cae sobre el techo.

K-1.def: clear liquid we drink
K-1.clip: Ana is thirsty. She fills a cup with water.
K-1.clipEs: Ana tiene sed. Llena un vaso con agua.

K-1.def: the part at the end of your arm
K-1.clip: Kofi raises his hand. The teacher calls his name.
K-1.clipEs: Kofi levanta la mano. La maestra dice su nombre.

K-1.def: feeling good and glad
K-1.clip: Mei gets a new puppy. She feels very happy.
K-1.clipEs: Mei recibe un perrito nuevo. Se siente muy feliz.

K-1.def: feeling unhappy
K-1.clip: Diego drops his ice cream. He feels sad.
K-1.clipEs: A Diego se le cae el helado. Se siente triste.

K-1.def: large in size
K-1.clip: A big truck stops by the school. A small car goes around it.
K-1.clipEs: Un camión grande se detiene junto a la escuela. Un carro pequeño lo rodea.

K-1.def: not large; little
K-1.clip: A small bird sits on a big tree. It sings a song.
K-1.clipEs: Un pájaro pequeño está en un árbol grande. Canta una canción.
K-1.q: What does the small bird do?

K-1.def: to move fast on your feet
K-1.clip: Aisha runs to the gate. She wants to be first.
K-1.clipEs: Aisha corre hacia la puerta. Quiere llegar primero.

K-1.def: to push up off the ground
K-1.clip: Noor jumps high. She lands in a puddle.
K-1.clipEs: Noor salta alto. Cae en un charco.

K-1.def: to put food in your mouth
K-1.clip: Lu and Sam eat lunch. They eat rice and beans.
K-1.clipEs: Lu y Sam almuerzan arroz con frijoles.

K-1.def: to rest with your eyes closed
K-1.clip: The baby sleeps in a small bed. Mom turns off the light.
K-1.clipEs: La bebé duerme en una cama pequeña. Mamá apaga la luz.

K-1.def: the color of a ripe tomato
K-1.clip: Ana paints a red kite. She paints the tail blue.
K-1.clipEs: Ana pinta una cometa roja y la cola azul.

K-1.def: the color of the sky on a clear day
K-1.clip: The sea looks blue today. A white boat floats on it.
K-1.clipEs: El mar se ve azul hoy. Un bote blanco flota en él.

K-1.def: a person you like and play with
K-1.clip: Mei and her friend share crayons. They draw a big sun.
K-1.clipEs: Mei y su amiga comparten crayones. Dibujan un sol grande.

K-1.def: a person who helps you learn
K-1.clip: The teacher reads a story. The class listens.
K-1.clipEs: La maestra lee un cuento. La clase escucha.

K-1.def: a thin tool for writing
K-1.clip: Omar sharpens his pencil. Then he writes his name.
K-1.clipEs: Omar saca punta a su lápiz. Luego escribe su nombre.

K-1.def: something you open to go in or out
K-1.clip: Kofi knocks on the door. His grandma opens it.
K-1.clipEs: Kofi toca la puerta. Su abuela la abre.

K-1.def: a tall plant with a trunk and leaves
K-1.clip: A bird builds a nest in the tree. It uses small sticks.
K-1.clipEs: Un pájaro hace un nido en el árbol con palitos.

K-1.def: the colorful part of a plant
K-1.clip: Ana picks a yellow flower for her mom. It smells sweet.
K-1.clipEs: Ana corta una flor amarilla para su mamá. Huele dulce.

K-1.def: an animal with wings and feathers
K-1.clip: A bird sings on the fence. Then it flies away.
K-1.clipEs: Un pájaro canta en la cerca y luego se va volando.
K-1.q: What does the bird do last?

K-1.def: an animal that lives and swims in water
K-1.clip: The fish swims in a bowl. Lu gives it food every day.
K-1.clipEs: El pez nada en una pecera. Lu le da comida cada día.

K-1.def: a white drink from a cow
K-1.clip: Diego pours milk on his cereal. Some milk spills.
K-1.clipEs: Diego echa leche en su cereal. Se derrama un poco.

K-1.def: food made from flour and baked
K-1.clip: Dad bakes bread on Sunday. The whole house smells good.
K-1.clipEs: Papá hornea pan el domingo. Toda la casa huele bien.

K-1.def: a round toy you throw or kick
K-1.clip: Noor kicks the ball to Aisha. Aisha kicks it back.
K-1.clipEs: Noor patea la pelota a Aisha. Aisha se la devuelve.

K-1.def: not warm; low in temperature
K-1.clip: It is a cold morning. Sam puts on his coat and hat.
K-1.clipEs: Es una mañana fría. Sam se pone el abrigo y el gorro.

K-1.def: very warm
K-1.clip: The soup is hot. Maya blows on it before she eats.
K-1.clipEs: La sopa está caliente. Maya sopla antes de comer.

K-1.def: toward a higher place
K-1.clip: The kite goes up in the wind. Ana holds the string.
K-1.clipEs: La cometa sube con el viento. Ana sostiene el hilo.

K-1.def: toward a lower place
K-1.clip: The leaf falls down from the tree. It lands on the grass.
K-1.clipEs: La hoja cae del árbol y aterriza en el pasto.

K-1.def: to move something so it is not shut
K-1.clip: Mei opens her lunch box. Inside is a peach.
K-1.clipEs: Mei abre su lonchera. Adentro hay un durazno.

K-1.def: to shut something
K-1.clip: Omar closes the window. The wind is loud.
K-1.clipEs: Omar cierra la ventana. El viento suena fuerte.
K-1.q: Why does Omar close the window?

K-1.def: to have fun with games or toys
K-1.clip: At recess, Kofi and Lu play tag. They laugh a lot.
K-1.clipEs: En el recreo, Kofi y Lu juegan a la traba. Se ríen mucho.

K-1.def: to look at words and know what they say
K-1.clip: Ana reads a book to her little brother. He likes the pictures.
K-1.clipEs: Ana le lee un libro a su hermanito. Le gustan los dibujos.

K-1.def: to make a picture with a pencil or crayon
K-1.clip: Diego draws a house with a red door. He adds a tree.
K-1.clipEs: Diego dibuja una casa con puerta roja y le añade un árbol.

K-1.def: to make music with your voice
K-1.clip: The class sings a song about the moon. Maya claps along.
K-1.clipEs: La clase canta una canción sobre la luna. Maya aplaude.

K-1.def: to move on your feet, not fast
K-1.clip: Noor and her dad walk to school. They pass a bakery.
K-1.clipEs: Noor y su papá caminan a la escuela. Pasan por una panadería.

K-1.def: to clean with water
K-1.clip: Sam washes his hands with soap. Then he dries them.
K-1.clipEs: Sam se lava las manos con jabón y luego se las seca.

K-1.def: the place where you live
K-1.clip: After school, Aisha goes home. Her cat meets her at the door.
K-1.clipEs: Después de la escuela, Aisha va a casa. Su gata la espera en la puerta.

K-1.def: furniture you sleep on
K-1.clip: Lu makes her bed. She puts the pillow at the top.
K-1.clipEs: Lu hace su cama y pone la almohada arriba.
K-1.q: Where does Lu put the pillow?

K-1.def: a seat for one person
K-1.clip: Kofi pulls out a chair. He sits next to Mei.
K-1.clipEs: Kofi saca una silla y se sienta junto a Mei.
K-1.q: Who does Kofi sit next to?

K-1.def: a flat top with legs for putting things on
K-1.clip: Mom puts bowls on the table. Dad adds the spoons.
K-1.clipEs: Mamá pone los platos hondos en la mesa. Papá agrega las cucharas.

K-1.def: a big vehicle that carries many people
K-1.clip: The bus stops at the corner. Ten children get on.
K-1.clipEs: El autobús para en la esquina. Suben diez niños.

K-1.def: a vehicle with four wheels
K-1.clip: The car waits at the red light. Then the light turns green.
K-1.clipEs: El carro espera en la luz roja. Luego la luz se pone verde.
K-1.q: What happens after the red light?

K-1.def: the bright ball we see in the night sky
K-1.clip: The moon is big and round tonight. Omar looks at it from his window.
K-1.clipEs: La luna está grande y redonda esta noche. Omar la mira por la ventana.
K-1.q: Where does Omar look at the moon from?

K-1.def: a bright light in the night sky
K-1.clip: Mei counts the stars from the yard. She counts to twelve.
K-1.clipEs: Mei cuenta las estrellas desde el patio. Cuenta hasta doce.
K-1.q: How many stars does Mei count?

K-1.def: air that moves
K-1.clip: The wind blows hard. Diego holds his hat with both hands.
K-1.clipEs: El viento sopla fuerte. Diego sostiene su gorro con las dos manos.

K-1.def: soft white flakes of frozen water
K-1.clip: Snow covers the yard. Ana and Lu build a snowman.
K-1.clipEs: La nieve cubre el patio. Ana y Lu hacen un muñeco de nieve.

K-1.def: the number after two
K-1.clip: Maya has three crayons. She gives one to Sam.
K-1.clipEs: Maya tiene tres crayones y le da uno a Sam.

K-1.def: a larger number or amount
K-1.clip: Kofi has five stickers. Aisha has more. She has eight.
K-1.clipEs: Kofi tiene cinco calcomanías. Aisha tiene más: tiene ocho.

K-1.def: to give some of what you have to others
K-1.clip: Noor has one big orange. She shares it with her friends.
K-1.clipEs: Noor tiene una naranja grande y la comparte con sus amigos.

K-1.def: to do something useful for someone
K-1.clip: Sam helps his mom carry bags. They go inside.
K-1.clipEs: Sam ayuda a su mamá a cargar bolsas. Entran a la casa.
K-1.q: What do they do after the bags?

K-1.def: nice to others
K-1.clip: A new student is shy. Maya is kind and says hello.
K-1.clipEs: Un estudiante nuevo es tímido. Maya es amable y lo saluda.

K-1.def: to pay attention to sounds
K-1.clip: Mei closes her eyes and listens. She hears a bird.
K-1.clipEs: Mei cierra los ojos y escucha. Oye un pájaro.

K-1.def: needing rest
K-1.clip: After the long walk, Omar is tired. He sits down to rest.
K-1.clipEs: Después de la larga caminata, Omar está cansado. Se sienta a descansar.

K-1.def: wanting food
K-1.clip: The puppy is hungry. Lu fills its bowl.
K-1.clipEs: El cachorro tiene hambre. Lu llena su plato.

K-1.def: to turn up the corners of your mouth
K-1.clip: Ana sees her friend and smiles. Her friend smiles back.
K-1.clipEs: Ana ve a su amiga y sonríe. Su amiga le sonríe también.

2-3.def: to find out how long, heavy, or full something is
2-3.ex: We measure the desk with a ruler.
2-3.clip: Ben measures his plant with a ruler. It is ten centimeters tall.
2-3.clipEs: Ben mide su planta con una regla. Tiene diez centímetros de alto.
2-3.q: What does Ben use to measure?

2-3.def: to look at how things are the same and different
2-3.clip: Kira compares a maple leaf and an oak leaf. The oak leaf has round edges.
2-3.clipEs: Kira compara una hoja de arce y una de roble. La hoja de roble tiene bordes redondos.

2-3.def: to say what you think will happen next
2-3.clip: Dark clouds cover the sky. Leo predicts that it will rain soon.
2-3.clipEs: Nubes oscuras cubren el cielo. Leo predice que lloverá pronto.

2-3.def: to see or hear something carefully
2-3.clip: Rosa notices a tiny seed under the bench. She picks it up.
2-3.clipEs: Rosa nota una semilla diminuta debajo del banco. La recoge.

2-3.def: the natural home of a plant or animal
2-3.ex: A pond is a frog's habitat.
2-3.clip: A frog lives in a pond. The pond is its habitat because it has water and food.
2-3.clipEs: Una rana vive en un estanque. El estanque es su hábitat porque tiene agua y comida.
2-3.q: Why is the pond a good habitat?

2-3.def: one of the four parts of the year
2-3.clip: A year has four seasons. In fall, the leaves change color. In winter, snow covers the ground.
2-3.clipEs: Un año tiene cuatro estaciones. En otoño, las hojas cambian de color. En invierno, la nieve cubre el suelo.

2-3.def: a large round object that moves around a star
2-3.clip: Earth is a planet. It moves around the sun once every year.
2-3.clipEs: La Tierra es un planeta. Gira alrededor del sol una vez al año.

2-3.def: a long trip from one place to another
2-3.clip: Amir and his family take a long journey by train. They watch the fields go by.
2-3.clipEs: Amir y su familia hacen un largo viaje en tren. Miran pasar los campos.

2-3.def: ready to do something even when you feel afraid
2-3.clip: Nina is nervous, but she is brave. She stands up and reads her poem.
2-3.clipEs: Nina está nerviosa, pero es valiente. Se pone de pie y lee su poema.

2-3.def: wanting to learn or know more
2-3.clip: Tomas is curious about ants. He asks the librarian for a book about them.
2-3.clipEs: Tomás tiene curiosidad por las hormigas. Le pide a la bibliotecaria un libro sobre ellas.

2-3.def: soft and careful, not rough
2-3.ex: Be gentle with the baby bird.
2-3.clip: Hana is gentle with the kitten. She pets it slowly and softly.
2-3.clipEs: Hana es gentil con el gatito. Lo acaricia despacio y con suavidad.
2-3.q: How does Hana pet the kitten?

2-3.def: extremely big
2-3.clip: The whale is enormous. It is longer than a school bus.
2-3.clipEs: La ballena es enorme. Es más larga que un autobús escolar.
2-3.q: What is longer than a school bus?

2-3.def: to speak very quietly
2-3.clip: Pia whispers a secret to her friend. Nobody else can hear it.
2-3.clipEs: Pía le susurra un secreto a su amiga. Nadie más puede oírlo.

2-3.def: to take something and give it back later
2-3.ex: I borrow a book from the library.
2-3.clip: Dev borrows a marker from Jo. He promises to return it after art.
2-3.clipEs: Dev pide prestado un marcador a Jo. Promete devolverlo después de arte.

2-3.def: to tell how or why something happens
2-3.clip: Ms. Cruz asks Lily to explain her answer. Lily shows the steps on the board.
2-3.clipEs: La Sra. Cruz le pide a Lily que explique su respuesta. Lily muestra los pasos en la pizarra.

2-3.def: to tell what someone or something is like
2-3.clip: Sam describes his lunch box. It is round, red, and has a dinosaur on it.
2-3.clipEs: Sam describe su lonchera. Es redonda, roja y tiene un dinosaurio.
2-3.q: What shape is the lunch box?

2-3.def: a number of people or things together
2-3.clip: The class works in groups of four. Each group gets a box of shells.
2-3.clipEs: La clase trabaja en grupos de cuatro. Cada grupo recibe una caja de conchas.
2-3.q: How many students are in a group?

2-3.def: something that repeats in a way you can predict
2-3.ex: Red, blue, red, blue is a pattern.
2-3.clip: Zoe makes a pattern with beads. She uses red, blue, red, blue.
2-3.clipEs: Zoe hace un patrón con cuentas. Usa rojo, azul, rojo, azul.

2-3.def: to put things into groups that go together
2-3.ex: We sort the buttons by color.
2-3.clip: Marco sorts the buttons by size. The big ones go in one cup.
2-3.clipEs: Marco clasifica los botones por tamaño. Los grandes van en un vaso.

2-3.def: to put a seed or young plant in the ground
2-3.ex: We plant beans in the garden.
2-3.clip: Ivy plants a bean seed in the soil. She covers it and waters it.
2-3.clipEs: Ivy siembra una semilla de frijol en la tierra. La cubre y la riega.
2-3.q: What does Ivy do after she covers the seed?

2-3.def: the dirt where plants grow
2-3.clip: The soil in the garden is dark and wet. Worms live in it.
2-3.clipEs: La tierra del jardín es oscura y húmeda. Allí viven lombrices.

2-3.def: a dark shape made when something blocks light
2-3.ex: My shadow is long in the evening.
2-3.clip: At noon, Kai's shadow is short. In the evening, it is long.
2-3.clipEs: Al mediodía, la sombra de Kai es corta. Por la tarde, es larga.

2-3.def: a place where people buy and sell things
2-3.clip: Grandpa buys tomatoes at the market. The seller puts them in a bag.
2-3.clipEs: El abuelo compra tomates en el mercado. El vendedor los pone en una bolsa.

2-3.def: a person who lives near you
2-3.clip: Mrs. Lee is a good neighbor. She feeds the cat when we travel.
2-3.clipEs: La Sra. Lee es una buena vecina. Alimenta al gato cuando viajamos.

2-3.def: a place where you can borrow books
2-3.clip: Every Friday, Omar goes to the library. He borrows two books.
2-3.clipEs: Todos los viernes, Omar va a la biblioteca. Pide prestados dos libros.
2-3.q: How many books does he borrow?

2-3.def: steps and ingredients for making food
2-3.clip: Abuela reads the recipe aloud. First, she mixes the flour and eggs.
2-3.clipEs: La abuela lee la receta en voz alta. Primero, mezcla la harina y los huevos.

2-3.def: one food that goes into a recipe
2-3.ex: Flour is an ingredient in bread.
2-3.clip: The soup has three ingredients: carrots, onions, and water.
2-3.clipEs: La sopa tiene tres ingredientes: zanahorias, cebollas y agua.
2-3.q: How many ingredients does the soup have?

2-3.def: something you use to do a job
2-3.clip: Dad uses a tool to fix the chair. He turns the screws with a screwdriver.
2-3.clipEs: Papá usa una herramienta para arreglar la silla. Aprieta los tornillos con un destornillador.

2-3.def: to make something new for the first time
2-3.clip: Lin wants to invent a way to carry books. She makes a bag with wheels.
2-3.clipEs: Lin quiere inventar una forma de cargar libros. Hace una mochila con ruedas.

2-3.def: to find or learn something for the first time
2-3.clip: The children discover a nest in the bush. They stay back and watch quietly.
2-3.clipEs: Los niños descubren un nido en el arbusto. Se quedan atrás y miran en silencio.
2-3.q: What do the children do after they find the nest?

2-3.def: paying attention so nothing goes wrong
2-3.clip: Ana is careful when she carries the full cup. She walks slowly.
2-3.clipEs: Ana es cuidadosa cuando lleva la taza llena. Camina despacio.

2-3.def: in a fast way
2-3.clip: The rabbit runs quickly across the field. The turtle goes slowly behind it.
2-3.clipEs: El conejo corre rápidamente por el campo. La tortuga va despacio detrás.

2-3.def: used to give the reason for something
2-3.ex: I wore a coat because it was cold.
2-3.clip: Jun stayed inside because it was raining. He built a tower with blocks.
2-3.clipEs: Jun se quedó adentro porque llovía. Construyó una torre con bloques.

2-3.def: earlier than something else
2-3.clip: Before lunch, the class washes their hands. After lunch, they go to recess.
2-3.clipEs: Antes del almuerzo, la clase se lava las manos. Después del almuerzo, salen al recreo.

2-3.def: later than something else
2-3.clip: After school, Dani plays soccer. Then he does his homework.
2-3.clipEs: Después de la escuela, Dani juega fútbol. Luego hace su tarea.
2-3.q: What does Dani do after school?

2-3.def: next to
2-3.ex: The lamp is beside the bed.
2-3.clip: The cat sits beside the window. A plant is beside the cat.
2-3.clipEs: El gato se sienta al lado de la ventana. Una planta está al lado del gato.

2-3.def: in the middle of two things
2-3.ex: The park is between the school and the store.
2-3.clip: The library is between the bakery and the bank. The bakery is on the left.
2-3.clipEs: La biblioteca está entre la panadería y el banco. La panadería está a la izquierda.
2-3.q: What is between the bakery and the bank?

2-3.def: in the inner part of something
2-3.ex: The keys are inside the box.
2-3.clip: Inside the box, Rita finds a small map. It shows a path to the lake.
2-3.clipEs: Dentro de la caja, Rita encuentra un mapa pequeño. Muestra un camino hasta el lago.

2-3.def: before all the others
2-3.clip: First, Eli draws a circle. Next, he adds two eyes.
2-3.clipEs: Primero, Eli dibuja un círculo. Luego, le añade dos ojos.

2-3.def: coming right after
2-3.clip: Mia picks the seeds. Next, she puts them in a cup of soil.
2-3.clipEs: Mia escoge las semillas. Luego, las pone en un vaso con tierra.

2-3.def: at the end, after a long time
2-3.clip: The class waits and waits. Finally, the bus comes and everyone cheers.
2-3.clipEs: La clase espera y espera. Por fin llega el autobús y todos aplauden.

2-3.def: to want to know about something
2-3.ex: I wonder why the sky is blue.
2-3.clip: Lena looks at the moon and wonders why it changes shape.
2-3.clipEs: Lena mira la luna y se pregunta por qué cambia de forma.

2-3.def: liked best
2-3.clip: Seth's favorite color is green. He wears a green hat every day.
2-3.clipEs: El color favorito de Seth es el verde. Usa un gorro verde todos los días.
2-3.q: What does Seth wear every day?

2-3.def: to gather things and keep them together
2-3.clip: Yuki collects smooth stones at the beach. She keeps them in a jar.
2-3.clipEs: Yuki colecciona piedras lisas en la playa. Las guarda en un frasco.
2-3.q: Where does she keep the stones?

2-3.def: to make something by putting parts together
2-3.clip: The team builds a bridge with sticks and tape. It holds two toy cars.
2-3.clipEs: El equipo construye un puente con palitos y cinta. Sostiene dos carritos de juguete.

2-3.def: the outside form of something, like a circle or square
2-3.ex: A ball has a round shape.
2-3.clip: The sign has a triangle shape. It has three sides and three corners.
2-3.clipEs: La señal tiene forma de triángulo. Tiene tres lados y tres esquinas.
2-3.q: How many sides does the sign have?

2-3.def: the line where something ends
2-3.ex: Do not stand near the edge.
2-3.clip: The paper has a straight edge. Abel cuts along the edge with scissors.
2-3.clipEs: El papel tiene un borde recto. Abel corta a lo largo del borde con tijeras.
2-3.q: What does Abel use to cut?

2-3.def: the point where two edges meet
2-3.clip: The table has four corners. Jade puts a cup on each corner.
2-3.clipEs: La mesa tiene cuatro esquinas. Jade pone un vaso en cada esquina.
2-3.q: How many cups does Jade use?

2-3.def: hard to lift; weighing a lot
2-3.clip: The box is heavy. Two students carry it together.
2-3.clipEs: La caja es pesada. Dos estudiantes la cargan juntos.

2-3.def: even and flat, with no bumps
2-3.clip: The stone is smooth and cool. The tree bark is rough.
2-3.clipEs: La piedra es lisa y fresca. La corteza del árbol es áspera.

2-3.def: bright because light bounces off it
2-3.clip: The new coin is shiny. The old coin is dull and dark.
2-3.clipEs: La moneda nueva es brillante. La moneda vieja es opaca y oscura.

2-3.def: to turn into ice when it gets very cold
2-3.clip: On a freezing night, the water in the bucket will freeze. In the morning, it is ice.
2-3.clipEs: En una noche helada, el agua del balde se congelará. Por la mañana, es hielo.
2-3.q: What is in the bucket in the morning?

2-3.def: to change from solid to liquid because of heat
2-3.clip: The snowman starts to melt in the sun. Soon only a hat is left.
2-3.clipEs: El muñeco de nieve empieza a derretirse al sol. Pronto solo queda un sombrero.
2-3.q: What is left at the end?

2-3.def: to stay on top of water
2-3.clip: The wooden boat will float. The metal key will sink.
2-3.clipEs: El bote de madera flotará. La llave de metal se hundirá.

2-3.def: to keep something in your mind
2-3.clip: Luz remembers to bring her library book. She puts it in her bag.
2-3.clipEs: Luz recuerda traer su libro de la biblioteca. Lo pone en su mochila.

2-3.def: to do something again and again to get better
2-3.clip: Cam practices the violin every day. His songs sound smoother now.
2-3.clipEs: Cam practica el violín todos los días. Sus canciones suenan mejor ahora.

2-3.def: to do something special for a happy event
2-3.clip: The family celebrates Grandma's birthday. They bring a cake and sing.
2-3.clipEs: La familia celebra el cumpleaños de la abuela. Llevan un pastel y cantan.

2-3.def: to greet someone in a friendly way
2-3.clip: The class welcomes a new student. They show her where to hang her coat.
2-3.clipEs: La clase le da la bienvenida a una nueva estudiante. Le muestran dónde colgar su abrigo.

2-3.def: feeling good about something you or someone did
2-3.ex: I am proud of my work.
2-3.clip: Tess finishes her puzzle all by herself. She is proud and shows it to her mom.
2-3.clipEs: Tess termina su rompecabezas ella sola. Está orgullosa y se lo enseña a su mamá.
2-3.q: Who does Tess show the puzzle to?

2-3.def: to find out how heavy something is
2-3.clip: Gus weighs the apples on a scale. They weigh two pounds.
2-3.clipEs: Gus pesa las manzanas en una balanza. Pesan dos libras.
2-3.q: What does Gus use to weigh?
